title: Juicy Crisp Ethiopian Narutomaki Fried Rice
description: A vegetarian Ethiopian dish featuring narutomaki, with a double-fry method for extra crispiness, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Double-fry the narutomaki strips in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per batch, then set aside on paper towels to drain excess oil.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1/4 cup of vegetable oil and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the grated carrots and cook until they start to soften.
Add the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula, and stir-fry for about 5 minutes, combining all the ingredients.
Add the double-fried narutomaki strips, and stir-fry for another minute.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the fried rice and stir-fry for a final minute.
Serve the Juicy Crisp Ethiopian Narutomaki Fried Rice hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
